target_customer: Consumers buying design led electric vehicles, plus suppliers and regional partners joining its modular platform
problem: Electric vehicle startups face huge tooling and factory costs; Olympian claims a modular architecture cuts tooling and labor costs so small runs of distinctive vehicles become viable.
business_model: vehicle sales with deposits and preorders, plus platform partnerships with suppliers and joint ventures; funded in part by retail crowdfunding
product_category: Electric vehicle manufacturer with modular platform

founders.name: Eren Canarslan
founders.background_notes: Worked on autonomous driving, EVs and satellites at Qualcomm, started as an electrical engineer in Ford R&D, and also worked at New York VC funds and European investment banks.

founders.name: Jasmine Sungu
founders.background_notes: Business development and automotive consulting background.

competitors.name: Aptera
competitors.what: Solar three wheeled efficiency EV taking preorders

competitors.name: Fisker
competitors.what: Asset light EV maker, Ocean SUV due late 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing, certifying and manufacturing road vehicles needs capital intensive hardware, safety and regulatory work far beyond what a small team could do quickly.

defensibility.rationale: Styling and a claimed modular architecture are the only differentiators, and no sourced production capacity or patents were found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Legacy automakers electrified aggressively; no incumbent copied or bought Olympian per the sources found.

market_need_then: Consumers and press showed interest in retro styled EVs; the company reports 790 plus orders and a 61M plus revenue backlog on its own YC page (self reported, deposits).

branding.name_origin: The O in Model O1 stands for Olympian per the company; Olympus is the platform name, framed as the Android of EVs.

identity.logo: has a logo section on its site; details not found
identity.visual_style: art deco styling, steel and wood interiors
identity.voice_and_tone: design led, aspirational; tagline Electric. Aesthetic. Modular.

branding.brand_signature: Art deco styled EVs with knobs, dials and a wood dashboard
branding.community_and_virality: Coverage in Carscoops and other auto press in January 2024, Luckbox magazine, a Product Hunt launch, and over 2,950 retail investors reported by the company.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive design drew auto press and thousands of retail investors, which helped fundraising, but no revenue or deliveries are sourced.

outcome_analysis: Olympian Motors is an active YC W22 EV startup using a modular platform and art deco styling to stand out in a capital hungry market. Press in early 2024 and retail crowdfunding gave it visibility and investor numbers, but sourced evidence of deliveries or production is missing, and funding totals are unverified, so its outcome is still open. The business faces the usual hardware and capital risks that sank earlier EV startups.
notes: Funding figures seen only in aggregators and unverified: a Wefunder Reg CF raise of about 1.34M closing April 2024 (p2pmarketdata), a Series A style Reg CF offering launched October 2026 with conflicting 5M and 8.9M figures, a 9.1M round dated April 2026 (Caplight), Climate Capital and Soma Ventures as investors, and about 125k from YC in 2021. None cross checked against an SEC Form C, so no rounds are recorded. The YC batch is Winter 2022. Competitor source dates are approximate years. Completeness pass: the Wefunder Reg CF campaign that raised 1,338,233 and closed 2024-04-29 is recorded from p2pmarketdata alone, not an SEC Form C. Other figures conflict (CB Insights 7.44M over 4 rounds, VCBacked 1.3M, Wefunder page 2.9M raised), so total raised is unknown and later rounds are not recorded.
